changelog:
hepha-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of the autonomous delivery loop skill
- Implements unattended plan → execute → check → review → commit cycles for coding tasks
- Automatically decomposes requirements, manages backlog/progress/decision logs in .autopilot/
- Performs schema validation, research, engineering checks, browser validation, and one-commit-per-loop workflow
- Includes clear stop and completion conditions, re-planning triggers, and strict commit policies
